correction.reason: Independent actual browser v1 receiving proved a malformed draft could block valid profile recovery, a malformed programmatic post-preview edit caused an uncaught parser error, and comma arrays remained unsavable under the earlier profile codec.
changes: The optional readInputState hook snapshots raw form strings and selected constraints for preview identity; its default remains readInputs for existing callers.
Save retains readInputs parsing and codec admission. A valid incoming file can replace an unfinished quoted draft; any raw post-preview change retires the preview without replacing the draft.
The profile codec admits commas now represented by the quoted form fields. Precisely its 203-byte comma-refusal block was removed; all other admission limits are unchanged.

README and the focused profile codec test explain and exercise the new interoperable comma/quote behavior. Taste parser/helper tests and markup are unchanged from the independently received #57 source.

limits: Existing saved-week taste strings containing CR/LF still meet the preexisting single-line HTML input boundary; before/after negative witnesses are preserved. Arbitrary native strings are not claimed to round-trip.

Planning-input files retain the 64 KiB, UTF-8/BOM/duplicate/unknown-field, native shape/count/codepoint/default, control-character and taste-edge U+FEFF restrictions. Native trimming applies; raw draft spacing is not serialized.
